title: From short notes to the monthly summary
completionMessage: Asha noted three expenses in one text box, saved them, saw the November summary, corrected one entry and deleted another. Each time the summary followed the saved entries (grand total {stats.grandTotal}). Open questions are listed in gaps/note-to-summary.md.

open-app.notDefined: How the user signs in (email and password, Google, another provider), how a new user gets an account, and whether there is sign-out are not defined (REQ-275 open questions).
open-app.performedText: opened the app and was asked to sign in

sign-in.performedText: signed in and reached the entry box

review.performedText: asked to review the four typed entries

save.performedText: saved the three valid entries; X 100 was not saved and its error stays shown

after-save.notDefined: What happens to the text box after saving (cleared, or failed lines kept for fixing), and whether saving the same text twice creates duplicates, are not defined (REQ-278 open questions).

entries-gap.notDefined: The spec describes no list of saved entries. Edit and delete (REQ-280, REQ-281) need one; its place, columns and order are not defined. The mock shows a plain list.

pick-edit.proposedAction: Click Edit on the Uber entry

edit-entry.performedText: opened the Uber entry to correct it

edit-gap.notDefined: Whether an entry is edited by re-typing the short form or field by field, and whether the abbreviation rules and errors apply to edits, are not defined (REQ-280 open questions). The mock shows the short form.
edit-gap.performedText: saw the entry as saved now

save-edit.performedText: corrected the Uber amount from 180.00 to 220.00

pick-delete.proposedAction: Click Delete on the Netflix entry

deleted.notDefined: Whether the user is asked to confirm a delete, and whether a delete can be undone, are not defined (REQ-281 open questions). The mock deletes at once.

final-summary.performedText: saw Travel at 220.00 and Entertainment gone; grand total {stats.grandTotal}
